note: Model list for the in-app Models tab. Sizes are approximate. Hashes come from the hosting service at download time and are shown to you; nothing here is pinned yet.

entries.name: ACE-Step v1 (3.5B) - songs with lyrics
entries.description: Full songs with vocals and lyrics, up to 4 minutes per clip. The default music model.
entries.notes: On 6GB cards use Safe memory mode (offload + int8).

entries.name: Stable Audio Open Small - fast instrumental clips
entries.description: Tiny and fast: up to 11 second instrumental clips and sound effects. No lyrics or vocals.
entries.notes: Gated: accept the licence on the model page, then set the HF_TOKEN environment variable before downloading.

entries.name: Kokoro 82M - fast talk voices (presets)
entries.description: Very light text-to-speech with ready-made voices. Runs on any GPU or on CPU. No voice cloning.
entries.notes: Weights are in a pickle-based format: only download from the publisher.

entries.name: Chatterbox - talk with voice cloning
entries.description: Speaks in the voice of a 5-15 second reference clip. The best quality for cloning a voice.
entries.notes: Falls back to CPU (slow) on small GPUs.

entries.name: OpenVoice v2 - change a singer's voice (converter)
entries.description: Small voice converter used by Re-voice. Needs a vocal-separation model as well.
entries.notes: Weights are in a pickle-based format: only download from the publisher.
